scientific_integrity: The source theorem is explicitly acknowledged as prior work; the stochastic trichotomy and its sharp consequences are proved with an exact algebraic factor comparison. Exact-rational finite checks support but do not replace the proof.
scientific_limitations: The comparison is only for marked vertices in the larger/equal part of a uniformly sampled spanning tree of complete bipartite graphs at fixed total order.
The exact path-distance distribution is an acknowledged consequence of the Ge–Dong prescribed-tree formula, not a new enumeration.
Historical priority of the full stochastic-order comparison is not conclusively established.
No claim is made at the asymptotic boundary x=2/3; no independent audit has been performed.
title: A complete one-crossing law for marked distances in bipartite uniform spanning trees
